purpose: Decodes a Uniswap v4 hook address's 14 permission bits (the low 14 bits of the address, per v4-core at the pinned commit a7cf038cd568801a79a9b4cf92cd5b52c95c8585, src/libraries/Hooks.sol) against a caller-declared callback set, and reconciles the two: each of the 14 flags (beforeInitialize through afterRemoveLiquidityReturnDelta) is reported MATCH, DECLARED_NOT_SET (the callback will never fire) or SET_NOT_DECLARED (the PoolManager calls an undisclosed function), with the mismatch count equal to the popcount of declared XOR actual. The node also replicates v4-core's isValidHookAddress validity rule: each return-delta flag requires its base flag, the zero address must not carry a dynamic fee, and a non-zero hook must have at least one flag set or a dynamic pool fee (pool_fee 0x800000), reporting valid_hook_address plus the failing rule. declared_permissions is accepted flat (all 14 booleans required; a missing key is a refusal, never a default) or in the Uniswap hooklist entry shape { hook.address, flags, properties.dynamicFee }; when a registry dynamicFee declaration is supplied it is reconciled with the caller's pool_fee (dynamic iff pool_fee equals 0x800000 exactly, per LPFeeLibrary.sol isDynamicFee; any other value is a static fee) and the declaration_source is emitted. standards_basis names the pinned v4-core commit. Zero network: the node never reads a chain and decodes only what the caller supplies; it states no opinion on whether a hook is safe or compliant.
